Main Gate Entrance Arch
Transform the entrance gate into a stunning first statement — choose your style
SVV Main Gate: The gate structure becomes our canvas. We build custom arch decoration around it — choose from Full Floral, Grand Statement, Aesthetic Drape or Modern styles. Fully removable after the event.

Portico Entrance

Photo Booth
Custom photo booth — the Instagram moment your guests will share all night
SVV Photo Booth: Set up in the designated SVV corner. Flower Wall (fresh rose panel), Couple Frame (name arch + neon sign), Traditional (jasmine curtain + kolam floor), LED Gold Frame (glows for evening selfies). Fits 4–6 guests per shot.

SVV Location 08
Pathway & Carpets
Aisle runners, petal trails, gold bollard stands & hanging passage decor
SVV Pathway: From entrance to stage — the aisle creates the mood. We offer Gold Bollard Stands (roses every 3ft), Petal Carpet (marigold + rose), Candle Lantern aisle, Full Floral arch pathway. Premium: overhead floral canopy tunnel over the full aisle.

Reception Stage
Main backdrop 55×36 ft — Full Floral, Aesthetic, Traditional & Dramatic
SVV Reception Stage (55×36): Our largest canvas. Custom framework dressed in your chosen style — Full Floral (wall-to-wall roses, orchids), Aesthetic (drapes + Edison lights), Traditional (marigold + jasmine), Dramatic (dark backdrop + LED rain).
